pokedexEntries.bk: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

pokedexEntries.wh: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

pokedexEntries.as: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

pokedexEntries.us: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.

pokedexEntries.um: It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.

pokedexEntries.sw: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.

pokedexEntries.sh: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
